description_en: Calls the ChangeResourceGroup operation to modify the resource group to which an Express Connect circuit resource belongs
description_zh: 调用ChangeResourceGroup接口修改物理专线资源所属的资源组
kebab_example: aliyun vpc change-resource-group --new-resource-group-id rg-bp1drpcfz9srr393h0000 --resource-type PHYSICALCONNECTION --resource-id pc-bp16qjewdsunr41m10000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ChangeResourceGroup

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the new resource group.

A resource group is a mechanism for managing resources by group within an Alibaba Cloud account. Resource groups help you address the complexity of resource grouping and authorization management within a single cloud account. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94475.html
parameters.help_zh:
要替换的新的资源组ID。

资源组是在阿里云账号下进行资源分组管理的一种机制，资源组能够帮助您解决单个云账号内的资源分组和授权管理等复杂性问题。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94475.html
parameters.name: new_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:
PHYSICALCONNECTION: Express Connect circuit instance.
VIRTUALBORDERROUTER: Virtual Border Router.
ROUTERINTERFACE: VBR uplink.
TRAFFICQOS: QoS policy
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。取值：
PHYSICALCONNECTION：表示高速通道专线实例。
VIRTUALBORDERROUTER：表示边界路由器。
ROUTERINTERFACE：表示VBR上连。
TRAFFICQOS：表示QoS策略
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Express Connect circuit resource whose resource group you want to modify
parameters.help_zh: 待修改资源组的物理专线资源ID
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the resource group that you want to modify.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的资源组所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
